finding.title: LinkHelper.profile_link renders the display name a user picked into every comment header.
finding.description: LinkHelper.profile_link renders the display name a user picked into every comment header. A display name such as may run script in readers' browsers. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content: # frozen_string_literal: true module LinkHelper # Build the profile link shown in comment headers. def self.profile_link(label, url) %(#{label}) end end

# frozen_string_literal: true require 'minitest/autorun' require 'link_helper' class LinkHelperTest < Minitest::Test def test_builds_link assert_includes LinkHelper.profile_link('Ann', '/u/ann'), '>Ann' end end
